findings.title: Committed-prefix histories contradict final histories, and stale-head rejection rewrites its input
findings.evidence: All three primitive histories consume prefix-2 to produce the final head, while each asserted complete final history consumes genesis instead. Prefixes 0,1,2 are explicitly materialized as committed states and negative admissionBoundary objects preserve them. At final step the current head is prefix-2, so consuming genesis violates current-head membership. A whole-oracle atomic summary could consume genesis, but no separate summary/history layer or mapping is defined. Mutation 12 selects mutStale as its preContext (historyHead and currentHeads hist:not-genesis-loan-bob) yet returns badDebt.preState with hist:genesis-loan-bob; its advertised empty rejected effects therefore change history.
findings.requiredFix: Choose and specify one admission model. For committed step successors, bind each final state/acceptance to its actual prefix-2 predecessor, retaining a separate complete chain/genesis record if needed. If whole-oracle atomicity is intended, distinguish speculative prefixes from committed negative contexts and provide their own admitted lineage. For the stale-head control, separate ledger preState from attempted admission input or return exactly the selected complete preContext; rejection must not restore an old head.

findings.title: Primitive updates and four-claim checks still do not define the complete finite transition
findings.evidence: Primitive update lists and named fullPostEquality/frame/ownership/current-head checks are useful additions, but no primitive application rules or complete record constructors bind their omitted fields. Refinance debtCreate supplies only principal/total/status, not the new debt's borrower, creditor, accrual, market aliases and financed fee record; dutyProduce supplies only an ID. Redemption has no explicit nominal-holder update or nominal share amount 100->60, and no observation writes for availableLiquidityUSDC 3800->0 and remainingExactUSDC creation. BadDebt debtWrite omits final open-impaired/lossAllocatedToShares changes; shareNAVWrite does not define removal of includesReceivable or the impaired receivable memo. IntentRefinement still says everyHardConstraintHasPlanWitness with pass=true without witnesses. Acceptance has no bound current semantics/key/spec registry or pre-verification resource inputs/predicates; the input packet requires unknownOrRevokedSemanticsReject and preVerificationBudgets. Positive genesis/admin remain prose summaries rather than a binding of the entire admitted preState.
findings.counterexample: Under literal field application, redemption's nominal holder remains alice unless tokenTransfer is separately defined to update nominal shares, and its observation availableLiquidityUSDC remains 3800 after the actual 3800 cash payment. The declared postState instead requires requestEscrow and liquidity 0. This is not full post equality. Changing new debt creditor or an unbound registry revocation flag likewise has no defined witness comparison in the stated checks.
findings.requiredFix: Define finite primitive semantics, typed/default constructors or resolved full-record replacements, and exact paths for every non-frame field. Express the four claims as predicates over those inputs, hard-constraint witnesses, full admitted genesis/admin context, registry/currentness and concrete budgets. Derive checks from state paths rather than recording self-reported pass flags. Include a full frame over the complement of actual writes. Runtime or proof implementation is not needed.

findings.title: Per-step footprints remain smaller than the actual committed-state changes
findings.evidence: Previously missing authority/duty/position names are added, but exact access accounting still fails. Every step changes historyHead/currentHeads/consumed/produced; perStep mostly lists only newly created prefix labels and omits currentHeads writes, predecessor consumption and later currentness reads. Redemption step 2 writes sharesLocked/sharesBurned/assetsClaimedUSDC/assetsRemainingExactUSDC and stored liquidity/remaining observations, but lists only request claimable/status/sharesClaimable plus balances, supply and fill authority. Its step 0 changes the nominal share holder and locked fields without a corresponding nominal share resource. BadDebt step 3 changes debt status/lossAllocatedToShares and allocatedLossUSDC observations, but the perStep list has no bob.debt or observation write. Aggregated bound=1 does not state whether it counts unique records or accesses: the actual listed work.lifetime accesses are 4, bridge balance writes 2 and redemption claimable writes 2. Prefix history creates are absent from the aggregate create list. Aliases such as duty.bob.remaining.600 versus duty.bob.serviceDebt.remaining.600 are not expanded by the supplied alias map.
findings.requiredFix: Declare unique-resource counts separately from per-step access bounds. Provide deterministic aliases to exact financial state paths and include all reads, writes, creations, deletions and consumptions from the complete-state diffs, including nominal ownership, observation updates and current history. Reconcile totals and budgets to those accesses; identifying omitted resource names alone does not close the finding.

findings.title: Funded replay and residual discharge controls still have unproved admission prerequisites
findings.evidence: The new replay is genuinely cash-funded: vaultDeployed 5700->1900 supplies vaultLiquid 0->3800, total USDC stays 9500, R1 claimable and sharesClaimable stay 0, and prior burn/authority/duty counters survive. However the replenishment has no admitted authority/controller, separate successor/currentness provenance or finite resource admission; it mutates complete financial state under the unchanged first-claim head. workCharge=0 and notSuccessorStepOfOriginalOracle=true disclose a cost choice but do not establish a legal external transition. The replay's type/authority/resource/currentness prerequisites are booleans; its proposed state raises assetsClaimed to 7600 while leaving remainingExact 5700 and burn/supply counters unchanged, so the exact-goal equation also fails (13300 != 9500). No ordering establishes that replay is the distinguishing failure. The residual write-off control correctly updates principal/accrual/total/status/discharged, but leaves the complete 600 service duty undischargeable and unchanged, creating a second debt/duty consistency failure without a defined order or full legal write-off candidate shape.
findings.requiredFix: Admit the replenishment under a complete explicit toy external boundary with named source controller/authority, conserved transfer, currentness/history scope and finite cost/resource accounting. State the candidate admission order and concrete inputs that pass before replay/claimable rejection, with later consistency checks explicitly unreachable, or construct a balanced legal-next-claim candidate differing only in the forbidden replay entitlement. For residual discharge, supply a complete authorized-discharge candidate shape including duty effects, then remove only the grant, or specify authorization rejection before downstream debt/duty checks. Preserve cash-funded and unfunded cases separately.
